text:
Sam K: Heads-up — planning a quick smokecheck for the llm-runner proxy sign-on tomorrow 10:00am PT. This is to validate LangChain + LlamaIndex adapter flows, gateway routing, and Dedicated/Private entitlements. I’ll paste a tiny checklist below. React with ✅ if you own a line.

Elaine G: I can own the Dedicated + Private env sanity tests (network, KMS, egress).

Raj P: I’ll do the LangChain adapter app flow and auth token exchange. Need a test client id/secret. @Sam K can we get a disposable creds?

Sam K: @Raj P — yes, creating a short-lived test creds set now. Will DM values. Also +1 on capturing CSP logs for any 401s.

Marie L: I’ll coordinate marketplace listing checks and the joint-announcement blackout window. We should avoid any public push for 48h around the smokecheck.

Sam K: Checklist (high-level):
• creds + token exchange tested (LangChain runner)
• gateway routing (+fallback) smoke
• Dedicated GPU pool routing + cold start check
• Private VPC connectivity & KMS (simulated customer keys)
• telemetry + billing tokens sanity
• marketplace integration smoke (manifest + listing pull)

Raj P: Quick smoke curl to validate proxy token path (for folks running local tests):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://proxy-smoke.redwood-inference/internal/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/7b","input":"hi"}' | jq .
```
Replace $SMOKE_TOKEN with the short-lived token Sam will DM.

Elaine G: Note for Private: if customer KMS keys are present the test should toggle key fallback to mock KMS. I’ll add a simple script to flip that in the env.

Sam K: @deploy-bot schedule smokecheck job for 2026-04-14T17:00:00Z (10am PT) and tag: llm-runner-proxy-smoke.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: llm-runner-proxy-smoke on 2026-04-14T17:00:00Z. Assigned owners: Elaine G, Raj P, Marie L. Links: https://ci.redwood-inference/smoke/1790123456

Marie L: For announcement blackout: blocked windows: 2026-04-13 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-16 00:00 UTC. I’ll update the comms calendar.

Raj P: Quick question — does the proxy expose per-tenant latency headers? I want to capture P50/P95 in the smoke run.

Sam K: Yes, proxy returns X-Redwood-Latency-ms and X-Model-Version headers. Capture them and add to the smoke script.

Elaine G: I’ll take the post-run checklist: collect logs, audit any 401/403s, run KV cache sanity (cold vs warmed). Plan to report in this thread after run.

Marie L: Adding marketplace owner: @Liam M (cc). Liam, we’ll need a quick smoke of listing metadata fetch (no publish) during the window.

Sam K: Perfect. If no objections, we’ll run tomorrow. Ping here if you need extra creds or test accounts. :thumbsup:
